verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Sentry ships its own MCP server so external AI assistants can call Sentry's tools (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-8, sentry-probe-3), which is the opposite role from the story — no evidence that Sentry itself consumes/plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools within its own product (e.g., in Seer or agent tracing).
